# shmuelie-devenv

Developer-environment skills for PowerShell profiles and local .NET MCP servers.

```text
copilot plugin marketplace add shmuelie/shmuelie-skills
copilot plugin install shmuelie-devenv@shmuelie-skills
```

## Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `powershell-profile` | Profiles, PSReadLine, prompts, worktree prediction, and terminal recovery |
| `local-mcp-server-development` | Local .NET MCP servers that automate desktop applications |
